subject: Business
title: Hiring Your First Ten
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Hiring Your First Ten.

hook.text: Your first ten hires define your startup's DNA. Every early employee shapes the culture forever.

buildup.text: Early employees need to be generalists who thrive in chaos — not specialists who need structure.

discovery.text: The best early hires are slightly overqualified people excited by the mission and autonomy.

twist.text: Hiring fast backfires. One toxic hire at employee five poisons the whole team.

climax.text: Stripe took months to hire their first employees, prioritizing quality over speed.

punchline.text: Hire slow at the start. You're building the foundation.

quiz.question: What type of employee works best in a very early startup?
options: Specialists with deep expertise in one area

details.summary: The first ten hires define a startup's culture, velocity, and trajectory more than any strategic decision. Early employees must be exceptional generalists who thrive in chaos, because they will build the processes, culture, and standards that every subsequent hire inherits and amplifies.

takeaways: First ten hires define culture, standards, and trajectory far beyond their individual roles
Early employees must be exceptional generalists comfortable with ambiguity and chaos
Hiring mistakes compound quickly when there are only ten people in the company

faq.question: What should founders prioritize when hiring the first ten employees?
faq.answer: Cultural alignment and adaptability over specific skills. Willingness to do whatever needs doing. High tolerance for ambiguity and changing priorities. Self-motivation that does not require managerial oversight. These people will define the company more than any strategy document.

faq.question: How do startups compete for talent against companies offering higher salaries?
faq.answer: Offer equity that aligns incentives. Sell the mission and the opportunity for outsized personal impact. Provide autonomy and responsibility that larger companies cannot match at the same level.
